transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?

Hi. Yeah, thanks. Well, I’m here because lately... I’ll get off a long shift at the shop, and I end up eating way more than I ever planned to. Like, I'll have a full fast-food meal, and then I just keep going with snacks and whatever else is in the fridge, all in one sitting. It's just been bothering me a lot.
Do you feel like you can’t control yourself or stop eating once you start these eating episodes?

Yeah, that's exactly it. Once I start on those nights, I mean... it feels like my hands just keep grabbing food. I'll be sitting there telling myself to stop, and I'm already feeling sick to my stomach, but I just can't seem to quit once I get going.
After these episodes where you feel like you can't stop eating, do you ever make yourself sick or do extra exercise to try to balance it out?

Yeah, I do. Most weeks, I'd say I have at least one night where I eat like that, and then... I try to make up for it. I'll make myself throw up, or sometimes I'll take laxatives. Other times I just skip meals the next day or work out extra hard to try and burn it all off. It's, uh... it's been going on for several months now.
Do you usually make yourself sick or take laxatives right after these large eating episodes, or is it sometimes unrelated to when you eat a lot?

It's always right after. Like, I'll finish eating all that food, and then I just get this... this panic about what it's going to do to my body. So, yeah, right after I eat too much, I'll go straight to the bathroom and make myself throw up, or I'll take the laxatives then. It's because I'm just so scared of what all that food is going to do to me.
Is the main reason you make yourself sick or take laxatives because you're worried about gaining weight or how your body looks after those eating episodes?

Yeah, that's definitely it. I just... I get really worried about gaining weight. Even when I'm at work and my work pants are actually feeling a little looser, if I step on the scale and it's up even just one pound, I just feel like I'm getting fat. I start worrying that I'm going to completely lose control of my whole body, you know? So, yeah, that's why I do it.
Do you ever make yourself sick or take laxatives when you haven't had one of these large eating episodes, just because you're worried about your weight or how you look?

No, not really. It's pretty much only tied to when I eat too much. I mean, I worry about my weight all the time, obviously, but... I don't usually throw up or take laxatives unless I've just had one of those big eating episodes and feel like I need to undo it.
